args.body: Apply your existing checkpoint assignment to the first due invoice/CSV or welfare release. Verify the applicable cutoff from the deployed revision and any superseding record. If it has passed, reuse any completed verdict or give ACQUISITION the evidence paths needed to close the existing mission. Keep eligible requests, completed deliveries, explicit paid interest, accepted orders and settled receipts distinct. The five unclassified sources leave request coverage incomplete. If the cutoff is still ahead, preserve it and avoid creating a parallel verdict. Keep welfare retirement after December 4 at 17:00 UTC.

description: The prime-subcontracting mission has a saved award-lead extract and an observed researcher claim. The next commercial test is whether a prime has an open request that an existing work sample can satisfy through an authorized route. Commercial feedback is available with zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so eligible demand remains unknown. The catalogue pilot depends on the operator’s send-or-decline decision. Interac order acceptance and settlement require separate administrative evidence. Verified available cash and revenue are both zero.
